text: This is our colony. Peaceful, beautiful, safe...
And here he is... the colony's new king!
King? I am the king of this colony!
Wrong answer.
I am the queen! The whole colony will see!
Wrong again.
Forget queens. I have more followers!
All three wrong. It all began yesterday evening...
...with just one banana.
That evening, just one monkey came.
Arey! A monkey! So auspicious!
Here, beta, eat banana. No evil eye!
A monkey! A real monkey! In our colony!
I have an idea! Let's keep him! Name... Mangal!
Keep him? Feed him what? Not my chips!
Shall I tell you? Monkeys are wild, not pets.
Quiet! Mangal is our friend.
Fine. I am writing this down.
We'll feed him daily. Lucky monkey!
Mangal ate... and phoned home.
The whole family.
Lucky... lucky... so very lucky...
Next morning... one monkey became twenty!
So many? Oh my God! So much luck!
Science says monkeys fear humans.
See, brother, science says, don't panic.
You are very tall... and very thin. Eat something!
I'm hungry! Aloo parathas, all four!
Faster than me? Me?! This is an insult!
Chew! Thirty-two times! Basic manners...
Hahaha, Laddu, you look... Arey! My sock!
Yesterday one. Today twenty-seven. Tomorrow?
Twenty-seven times lucky!
Did you hear? Monkeys in the colony!
Lakhan's glasses gone, Laddu's tiffin gone...
...but mine? Nothing of mine will go!
Arre! My phone!
Aunty, he gossips better than you!
Don't laugh! Three hundred groups in there!
Let's go, let's go! Get the phone back!
Uff! Every important day... every time!
One, two, three... not one banana less!
Count again... one... two... oh my God! Missing!
Lallan Seth! Our rice!
Touch it, I dare you!
Even the monkey fears her. I'm not alone!
Hello friends! We're live! Monkey special!
Look, my fans! Hi, monkey!
My live! My ring light! My career!
Ten lakh people... on a monkey's live!
That morning, the colony's biggest influencer... was a monkey.
...I followed him too.
By afternoon, an emergency colony meeting began.
Silence! One by one! Raise your hand!
You are not colony members!
I fear nobody! I'll catch the monkey!
Scared of a lizard, and catching monkeys?
I was... checking the pillar's strength.
Evil eye! Lemon-chilli on every house!
Let anyone touch my laddoos!
Did you hear? Monkeys can smell sweets...
Shall I tell you? Monkeys are coming because...
Kids, don't interrupt! Elders' meeting!
Quiet! Listen to brother...
Relax! I have a plan!
Elders' meeting. Kids' talk... tomorrow.
Behold, science! Banana in, monkey in, dhadaam!
Papa, the monkey is up on the tree...
Let me just straighten the banana...
I fear nobody... Get me out!
Is Uncle okay? Is the banana okay?
Enough! Now I'll handle it.
I left him on purpose. Took pity.
Relax! The langur has arrived!
Chacha, you look like... a bigger monkey.
Exactly! Monkeys fear langurs!
Hoo-hoo-ha-ha! Run, everyone!
Arey? They're... bowing?
I am their king! Maharaj Tinku!
Hahaha, it tickles! Arey, I have no lice!
Did you hear? Tinku became chief of the monkeys!
Out! With your whole army!
Sigh. Tension... just a little.
Inquiry! Whole colony will be inquired!
The inquiry began. Two minutes later...
Samosa? Inquiry!
Jai Hind! Oh my God! Arey... my cap!
Head office! Monkeys have arrested my cap!
Uncle, half samosa. Only half.
My besan laddoos! The whole colony will see!
My laddoos!
Today you won't escape.
And so began... the biggest race in colony history!
Dadi! Dadi! Dadi!
Dadi versus monkey! We're live!
Go, Kusum Dadi!
Forty laddoos... four hundred rupees gone!
Mother's aim... missed?
First time... first time in my life!
The whole colony watched... Dadi's aim miss.
Quiet! Everyone quiet! Now brother speaks!
Shall I tell you? Come with me.
Behind the colony... the monkeys' free hotel.
Chhee! Whose garbage is this?
...could be anybody's.
Open garbage, daily bananas... free food!
Free food, monkeys come. Simple maths.
Science says monkeys love us!
They love food. And you love dustbins.
Feed them, fear of humans ends. Then snatching.
And our chips and sweets make monkeys sick too.
I only gave one banana... for luck.
The daily feeding idea... was mine.
I only... one chip.
Enough! My turn now.
Seth! Broom!
One broom, two broom... free labour!
Now only I will eat bananas.
Hello, forest department? Monkeys in our colony. Please come.
Don't worry, no? Our team will take them safely, slowly.
No hitting, no scaring, no feeding. Only love, accha?
For the first time ever... Raju's auto did not stop.
Come on, we've reached! Now you sleep.
Relax! They listen to me!
Did you hear? Hehe! The monkey returned my phone!
Inquiry... complete!
Oh... you are a lamp post. Sorry.
Collab! Pinky and Monkey!
Next time... my aim won't miss.
Keep the tail... to remember me.
The monkeys went home... to the forest.
But Dadaji, feeding bananas to monkeys is lucky, isn't it?
Feeding animals is not love...
...let the jungle stay a jungle.
Cover your garbage. See monkeys, call the forest department.
And no teasing! Understood? Quiet!
So this lucky banana... mine!
Now practice! I must get my aim back!
Maa!
Aim is back!
